title.en: The term of equal all along

t.zh: <level-ref to="q-trans"></level-ref>把两个等式连成了一个。写成证明项。
t.en: <level-ref to="q-trans"></level-ref> joined two equations into one. Write it as a term.

after.zh: 自反、对称、传递，写成证明项都只用 rfl 和 ▸。
after.en: Reflexive, symmetric, transitive: as terms, all three use only rfl and ▸.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: 用一个等式把要证的那句换一换，换出来的应当正是另一个已知。
hint.en: Use one equation to change the sentence to prove; what comes out should be the other given.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。

hint.zh: q 倒着也一样用：核两边都试。
hint.en: q works the other way round too: the kernel tries both sides.

hint.zh: 五层 fun：三样东西，两个等式。
hint.en: Five funs: three things and two equations.
